text: README.md documents no-install `uvx --from git+https://github.com/selkios/outcomegraph og ...` flows, installed `og` flows for init/sync/status, source-checkout development via `uv run og <command>`, and daemon install/start/status usage. It also states that `og daemon install` writes a launcher pinned to the current interpreter and module context and that daemon runtime does not implicitly fetch remote repository HEAD after install.
